blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Hidden beneath mountains, forests and watersheds, Philippine caves shelter wildlife, preserve geological formations and hold traces of the past. Yet these natural environments face threats from human activities, raising concerns over their long-term protection. Even in Metro Manila, a natural cave system survives amid the urban landscape. Apugan Cave, located within the La Mesa Watershed Reservation, is recognized by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-National Capital Region (DENR-NCR) as the region’s only known natural cave system.
